summary: The team is executing a seven-month SEO/AI-search visibility strategy prioritizing Asia Star and Intelligent China, while finalizing the knowledge website redesign and managing a time-sensitive event cancellation and content updates.
summaryDetail: The top priority is the global marketing strategy, with Asia Star and Intelligent China as the lead programs; Joseph must draft the target areas/prompts document and the team needs to analyze Asia Star participant profiles and CRM hot leads to inform the campaign. This week, urgent tasks include finalizing the knowledge website redesign by combining the two design concepts, integrating BCI and BSI indices, and scheduling a follow-up review; also, the team must resolve the Outlook account lockout by re-logging in all devices and confirm backend access. Looking ahead, the Intelligent China webpage launch and traffic drive are critical, while the cancellation of the November 13 CKGSB–EuroCham Shanghai event requires Ira's review of the draft email and Julie's feedback on the ESG and Social Innovation webpage. Additionally, the October timesheet explanations are due by noon, and Johnny needs to create the Chinese event webpage for the 2026 Women's Leadership Forum.
